name: Expert_ABH_BH_MFI
summary: This EA uses the MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average as a momentum signal filter within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold values applied to the CBH_BH_MFI signal, with fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop. The strategy relies on the MFI indicator's ability to detect market momentum shifts combined with a MA filter to reduce noise.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MFI（市场促进指数）指标并通过移动平均线平滑处理作为动量信号过滤器，基于MQL5标准库专家框架运行。根据CBH_BH_MFI信号的阈值来判断开仓和平仓，采用固定手数资金管理且无追踪止损。策略依赖MFI指标检测市场动量变化，结合MA过滤减少噪音。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Market Facilitation Index（MFI）指标，通过计算MFI的移动平均值来识别市场动量的变化方向。入场条件是当CBH_BH_MFI信号值超过开仓阈值（默认40）时开仓，信号值低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓，采用0-100的阈值体系进行信号过滤。出场条件完全依赖信号阈值触发平仓，未设置止损（StopLevel=0）和止盈（TakeLevel=0），这是显著的风险缺陷。仓位管理采用固定手数方式（默认0.1手），由CMoneyFixedLot类实现，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用10%的百分比参数和固定手数，缺乏基于波动率或风险比例的动态仓位计算。整体策略框架依赖MQL5标准库的CExpert信号多过滤器架构，但本EA仅使用单一MFI过滤器，信号来源较为单一。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Market Facilitation Index (MFI) indicator, using a moving average of MFI to identify shifts in market momentum direction. Entry conditions trigger when the CBH_BH_MFI signal value exceeds the opening threshold (default 40), and exit conditions trigger when the signal drops below the closing threshold (default 20), employing a 0-100 threshold system for signal filtering. Exit conditions rely entirely on signal threshold-based closing with no Stop Loss (StopLevel=0) and no Take Profit (TakeLevel=0) configured, which is a significant risk deficiency. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (default 0.1 lots) implemented by the CMoneyFixedLot class, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management uses a 10% percent parameter with fixed lots, lacking dynamic position sizing based on volatility or risk proportion. The overall strategy framework leverages the MQL5 Standard Library CExpert multi-filter signal architecture, but this EA only uses a single MFI filter, making the signal source relatively one-dimensional.

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdOpen
parameters.description_en: Open signal threshold [0...100], open when signal exceeds

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdClose
parameters.description_en: Close signal threshold [0...100], close when signal falls below

parameters.name: Signal_PriceLevel
parameters.description_en: Trade execution price level, 0 for market execution

parameters.name: Signal_StopLevel
parameters.description_en: Stop loss level (points), 0 means no SL set

pros: 使用MQL5标准库CExpert框架，代码结构规范清晰，易于维护和扩展
MFI指标结合MA平滑可以有效过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号
阈值体系（0-100）提供灵活的信号强度控制，可调节开平仓敏感度
框架支持多过滤器扩展，可方便添加其他信号源进行确认
pros_en: Uses the MQL5 Standard Library CExpert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
MFI indicator combined with MA smoothing effectively filters market noise and reduces false signals
Threshold system (0-100) provides flexible signal strength control for tuning entry/exit sensitivity
Framework supports multi-filter extension, making it easy to add additional signal sources for confirmation
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，完全没有硬性风险保护，极端行情下可能遭受巨大亏损
仅依赖单一MFI信号过滤器，信号来源单一，缺乏多维度市场分析
固定手数资金管理无法根据市场波动率和账户风险动态调整仓位
无追踪止损机制（使用TrailingNone），盈利头寸无法锁定浮盈
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Both Stop Loss and Take Profit are set to 0, providing no hard risk protection which could lead to catastrophic losses in extreme market conditions
Relies on a single MFI signal filter only, making the signal source one-dimensional and lacking multi-dimensional market analysis
Fixed lot money management cannot dynamically adjust position size based on market volatility or account risk
No trailing stop mechanism (uses TrailingNone), meaning profitable positions cannot lock in floating gains
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially opening positions under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，至少设置默认止损以防止极端亏损，建议根据ATR动态设置止损距离
增加多时间框架确认或其他指标过滤器（如趋势方向MA、成交量确认），提高信号可靠性
实现基于波动率（ATR）的动态仓位管理和追踪止损，替代当前的固定手数和无追踪止损方案
improvements_en: Add Stop Loss and Take Profit parameters with at least a default SL to prevent extreme losses; consider ATR-based dynamic stop distance
Add multi-timeframe confirmation or additional indicator filters (e.g., trend-direction MA, volume confirmation) to improve signal reliability
Implement volatility-based (ATR) dynamic position sizing and trailing stop to replace the current fixed lot and no-trailing-stop approach

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，完全没有硬性风险保护措施
单一指标信号源容易在震荡市中产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
无点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利入场
挂单过期仅4根K线，可能在低流动性时段频繁触发和过期
risk_points_en: Stop Loss and Take Profit are both 0, providing absolutely no hard risk protection
Single indicator signal source is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No spread filter may result in unfavorable entries under high spread conditions
Pending order expiration of only 4 bars may cause frequent triggering and expiration during low liquidity periods
